note: Parameterized OpenSearch query bodies for SearchIndexTool. Placeholders are ${param}. Every clause is composed only from behaviours verified in the discovery session (provenance per template). Templates flagged verified_clauses_complete:false contain at least one clause not exercised in discovery; run the matching gap query from discovery-gaps.md before relying on it. Validate arguments with server/chat/knowledge.mjs validateTemplateArgs — never send a field that is not in schema-registry.json.

cycle.description: release cycle prefix, e.g. CMSSW_20_1_X or CMSSW_20_1_ROOT6_X

from_ms.description: epoch millis lower bound (unverified field type)

to_ms.description: epoch millis upper bound (unverified field type)

templates.description: Document counts per release name, newest-first per cycle. Correct way to find the latest IB of a cycle: pick the first bucket whose key starts with the cycle prefix; the date suffix sorts lexicographically = chronologically within a cycle. Never treat the first bucket overall as latest.

Two-part recipe. Part 1: run release_doc_counts. Part 2 (client side): take the first bucket key starting with '${cycle}_' — that is the latest IB of the cycle. Report the retrieval time; counts drift while an IB is running.
templates.selection: first key with prefix '${cycle}_' in _key-desc order

templates.description: All architectures present with document counts (complete: sum_other_doc_count was 0 in the verified run).
Top workflows by document count. The verified run had doc_count_error_upper_bound 5126 — treat as approximate and say so.
Exit-code histogram (integer keys). Add a term filter on release to scope it to one IB.

Failed step documents (exitcode exists and != 0), optionally scoped to one release/architecture/workflow. Do not filter on exists(exception): failed steps often have no exception field. Exclude noisy fields from _source.
templates.optional_clause_note: Remove filter clauses whose parameter is not supplied (an empty term would match nothing). The sort clause is UNVERIFIED (no sort was executed on @timestamp in the discovery); drop it if the query is rejected and re-run unsorted.

templates.description: For one IB: failed steps grouped by architecture, with failing workflows per architecture. Verified result shape for CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-11-16-2300: 15 failed steps (el9_amd64_gcc14: 12, el9_aarch64_gcc14: 2, el8_amd64_gcc14: 1) — a snapshot of a possibly still-running IB.
Sample documents of one IB (one release across all generations/architectures). Use _source excludes to keep responses small; metrics fields make full documents huge.
templates.optional_clause_note: Remove the architecture clause when not supplied.

templates.description: Documents carrying an exception field, optionally scoped to one release. Remember: absence of exception does not mean success and presence does not mean failure.
templates.optional_clause_note: Remove the release clause when not supplied.

templates.description: Documents in an epoch-millis window on @timestamp. The range clause is UNVERIFIED: no range query appears in the discovery and @timestamp is an observed integer, not a confirmed date mapping. Run gap query G4 first.
